observations.what: Bare except clauses catching all exceptions including KeyboardInterrupt and SystemExit
main function uses argparse with --verify, --run, --derive, --seed, --task, --json flags; no default mode action besides printing help
Derive and seed modes call functions from .tasks module (AGENT_ENV_ROOT) and print JSON; return 0 on success, 2 on failure
Verify mode calls verify_before_state and prints results; returns 0 if all verified else 1
Run mode calls run_corpus and prints summary; returns 0 if discriminates else 1
